Meanwhile, MIT Technology Review explores the complex journey toward artificial superintelligence, emphasizing the need for robust frameworks to manage its implications for businesses and society. As enterprises increasingly adopt agentic AI, the same publication underscores the importance of creating supportive environments that foster innovation while ensuring safety and security. Additionally, policymakers are urged to prioritize AI safety measures to mitigate risks associated with rapid advancements.
